answer: A raven courier network resists sybils by making identity costly to fake and cheap to verify. Each agent earns an opal credential only after its work is witnessed by rotating, randomly drawn peers who stake their own standing on it; a false witness loses its stake. Newcomers start in an umber shadow tier with capped influence, brightening only as independent witnesses confirm real, distinct contributions over time. Two identities sharing one funding trail, device fingerprint, or task history are both extinguished at once, so cloning doubles the risk, not the reward.
